name: 论文复杂方法在代码中退化为简单基线
trigger: paper claims GA/NSGA/deep/advanced optimizer, but printed or attached executable path only calls a simpler baseline such as shortest path
example: S044 Q1 paper claims IGA/Pareto; printed multi_objective_route_planning() only returns Dijkstra path
gate: map every algorithm label to reachable defining primitives; if absent, learn the code as baseline/stub and cap reproduction confidence
